title: 알고리즘의 온기
suno_analysis_sp: K-pop and synth-pop track in G major at 124 BPM. The arrangement features a bright, plucked synth bass playing syncopated eighth notes and a four-on-the-floor kick drum. High-frequency synth pads provide harmonic texture while a clean, rhythmic electric guitar plays muted staccato chords on the off-beats. Female vocals are processed with light compression and subtle pitch correction, featuring a mix of chest voice and airy falsetto in the higher register. The percussion includes a crisp electronic snare and shimmering hi-hats. A recurring melodic synth motif uses a short decay and bright resonance.
